%% cvforge-template v1
%% sections: experience, skills, education
%% max-bullets-per-role: 4
%
% Two-column fixture: must raise the two-column lint warning.
\documentclass[11pt]{article}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=2cm]{geometry}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage{paracol}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\begin{document}
{\LARGE\bfseries \VAR{person.name}}\par
\VAR{person.email}\par
\begin{paracol}{2}
\textbf{Skills}\par
\BLOCK{for s in skills}
\VAR{s}\par
\BLOCK{endfor}
\textbf{Education}\par
\BLOCK{for ed in education}
\VAR{ed.degree}, \VAR{ed.org}, \VAR{ed.end}\par
\BLOCK{endfor}
\switchcolumn
\BLOCK{for job in experience}
\textbf{\VAR{job.title}}, \VAR{job.org}, \VAR{job.start} -- \VAR{job.end}\par
\begin{itemize}
\BLOCK{for b in job.bullets}
  \item \VAR{b.text} % id:\VAR{b.id}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{itemize}
\BLOCK{endfor}
\end{paracol}
\end{document}
